notes.title: 0.7.2Version update
notes.content:
The battle mode changes from the original 40 - health - point setting to a status - bar plan. With the ebb and flow of the battle, there are stone giants that can help with defense and a final fortress on the status - bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342261/412f299b93bef6c4859ab0a19b41e2cba9dc9e23.jpg[/img]

Guess: A guessing mini-game is added to the start menu. You can bet 5 gold coins to guess which side, the red team or the green team, will win (with random heroes and random skills).
